title: Checkout DB timeout triage
content: If checkout-api has DB_TIMEOUT and rising p95 latency, check connection pool usage, recent deploy, and failover events.

title: TLS certificate expiry handling
content: Rotate certificates, validate trust chain, restart edge proxies, and monitor error burn rate.

title: Memory leak and OOM handling
content: Capture heap dump, rollback recent release, and enable memory profile sampling.

title: Kafka lag remediation
content: Scale consumers, inspect broker health, and verify partition assignment.

title: Upstream timeout handling
content: Trace upstream calls, review retry budget, and isolate degraded dependency.
